book.name: LUCAS
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U LUCAS Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Lucas tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Ni tul taama u Jesús
As tul kuxh bꞌuuqꞌ qꞌii tu u bꞌaxa qꞌiieꞌ tu xhemaana,

as bꞌen veꞌt unqꞌa ixojeꞌ kꞌatz u juleꞌ uvaꞌ mujlukat u Jesús. As eqꞌomalik veꞌt unqꞌa txꞌumtxꞌulla tzꞌakabꞌaleꞌ taꞌn chaꞌma uvaꞌ maꞌtik ibꞌanat chaꞌma tucheꞌ, tiꞌ bꞌen toksat tiꞌ vichiꞌol u Jesús, uvaꞌ nik taleꞌ. As antik kaꞌt unqꞌa ixoj xekik tiꞌ chaꞌma.
As tul oon veꞌt chaꞌma tziꞌ u juleꞌ, as til veꞌt chaꞌma uvaꞌ bꞌalqꞌumalik veꞌt el u sivaneꞌ uvaꞌ atik tziꞌ u juleꞌ.
As ok veꞌt chaꞌma tu u juleꞌ. As til veꞌt chaꞌma uvaꞌ yeꞌlik veꞌt vichiꞌol u Kubꞌaal Jesús atike.
As sotz veꞌt ikꞌuꞌl chaꞌma. As txaklik kuxh veꞌt chaꞌma tzitziꞌ. As aat kuxh til veꞌt chaꞌma uvaꞌ txaklik veꞌt ok kaꞌvaꞌl unqꞌa naj txala chaꞌma uvaꞌ vaꞌlik chit ilitzꞌkabꞌan unqꞌa toksaꞌmeꞌ.

As aal chit xoꞌv veꞌt chaꞌma. As qaaebꞌ veꞌt chaꞌma vatz unqꞌa najeꞌ techal toon ivatz chaꞌma vatz txꞌavaꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa naj ileꞌ te chaꞌma: —¿Kam qꞌi uveꞌ nu kuxh echuk u Jesús xoꞌl unqꞌa kamnajeꞌ? Tan yeꞌl Aak kamnajle,
tan kat ulyu veꞌt taama Aak. As yeꞌl veꞌt Aak at tzitzaꞌ. Etulsataj viyol Aakeꞌ sekꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ tal kan Aak sete tul uvaꞌ atik Aak tu u Galilea,

tan ech kat tal kan Aak ileꞌ: «La aqꞌax ok VIKꞌAOL U NAJEꞌ tiqꞌabꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌ ni niman u Tiixheꞌ. As la kam veꞌt vatz u kuruseꞌ. As titoxvu qꞌii la ul taama unpajte,» tiꞌk Aak,— tiꞌk unqꞌa najeꞌ tal te chaꞌma.
As ul veꞌt viyol u Jesús skꞌuꞌl chaꞌma.
As el veꞌt chꞌuꞌl chaꞌma tu u juleꞌ. As bꞌex tal veꞌt chaꞌma te junlaval unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ Aakeꞌ tukꞌ te unjoltu unqꞌa niman tetz Aakeꞌ kam uvaꞌ til chaꞌma.
Antik u Maꞌleꞌ uvaꞌ tzaanaj tu Magdala, tukꞌ u Xhiv, tukꞌ umaꞌt u Maꞌl uvaꞌ vitxutx u Jacobo, tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa ixoj, as aꞌ chaꞌmaeꞌ ul alon te unqꞌa apóstol.
As jit inima chajnaj viyol unqꞌa ixojeꞌ, tan chꞌuꞌjil elnallukat chaꞌma nikat tal chajnaj.

As txakpu veꞌt u Luꞌeꞌ. Oojeꞌl chit veꞌt tel chꞌuꞌl naj tiꞌ bꞌen tilat u juleꞌ uveꞌ mujlukat u Jesús. As tul oon naj, as sajin ok naj tu u juleꞌ. As aꞌ kuxh unqꞌa maantaeꞌ til veꞌt naj uveꞌ bꞌochlukat u Jesús. As vaꞌlik chit teqꞌot veꞌt taama naj tiꞌ uveꞌ til naj. As bꞌen veꞌt naj tu kabꞌal.
Nikꞌuch tibꞌ u Jesús vatz kaꞌvaꞌl unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ
As an chit tu qꞌiieꞌ, as bꞌen veꞌt kaꞌvaꞌl vichusulibꞌ u Jesús tu umaꞌl u tal tenam uvaꞌ Emaús. Kamal oxvaꞌl iꞌl ixoꞌl tukꞌ u Jerusalén.
As tul nikat ixaan chajnaj, as nikat iyolbꞌe chajnaj kam chit uveꞌ kat uchi.
As tul nikat iyolon chajnaj, as jetzꞌen veꞌt ok u Jesús tiꞌ ixekebꞌ tiꞌ chajnaj.
As at kuxh til chajnaj uvaꞌ xekik umaꞌl u uxhchil tiꞌ chajnaj. As jit texhla chajnaj uvaꞌ aꞌik u Jesús.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ te chajnaj: —¿Kam yolileꞌ qꞌi uveꞌ neyoleꞌ tul nexaaneꞌ? ¿As kam uveꞌ nu kuxh etxumuneꞌ?— tiꞌk Aak.
As umaꞌl u naj uvaꞌ Cleofas ibꞌii as ech tal naj ileꞌ: —¿Ma jit axh aatenam bꞌa? ¿As ma yeꞌ ootzimal bꞌa aꞌn kam uveꞌ kat uch tu u Jerusalén tu unqꞌa qꞌiieꞌ?— tiꞌk naj.

Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —¿As kam qꞌi kat uchi?— tiꞌk Aak. As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ: —¿As ma yeꞌ kat aabꞌi bꞌa tiꞌ uveꞌ kat ulbꞌel u Jesús uvaꞌ aa Nazaret? As Aakeꞌ qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ. As nim chit unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ kat ikꞌuch Aak tukꞌ uveꞌ kat tal Aak vatz u Tiixheꞌ as vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ unpajte.
Pet aꞌ unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tukꞌ unqꞌa iqꞌesal u tenameꞌ uvaꞌ kat kꞌujbꞌaꞌn tiꞌ ikam Aak vatz u kuruseꞌ. As kat aqꞌpik veꞌt jeꞌ Aak vatz u kuruseꞌ.
Pet ech koj oꞌ, tan aꞌ kat qala uvaꞌ Aakeꞌ la qꞌalpun u kutenameꞌ vatz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ nichꞌoꞌn taama sqiꞌ. As yeꞌ kat bꞌex ibꞌana, tan kat ibꞌanlu veꞌt oxvaꞌl qꞌii ikam veꞌt Aak.
As kat sotz veꞌt kukꞌuꞌl tul kat ul tal kaꞌl unqꞌa ixoj sqe tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam kat til chaꞌma, tan kuꞌsaj kat bꞌex chaꞌma kꞌatz u juleꞌ uveꞌ mujlukat Aak.
As yeꞌl veꞌt vichiꞌol Aakeꞌ kat ilej veꞌt chaꞌma tu juleꞌ. As ni tal veꞌt chaꞌma uvaꞌ kat ikꞌuch tibꞌ kaꞌl unqꞌa ángel vatz chaꞌma. As kat tal unqꞌa ángel te chaꞌma uvaꞌ isleꞌl veꞌt Aak.
As yak kuxh bꞌen veꞌt kaꞌl unqꞌa kumool. Bꞌex til veꞌt chajnaj u juleꞌ. As ni tal chajnaj uvaꞌ an chittuꞌ kam uvaꞌ kat tal unqꞌa ixojeꞌ. As jit til chajnaj u Jesús,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —¡Ex chit yeꞌ nepal stuul! ¡Kam chit alkin aamaileꞌ vetetzeꞌ! Tan yeꞌxh nenima unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn unqꞌa qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ.
¿As moj yeꞌ ootzimal setaꞌn uvaꞌ techanal la ipalebꞌe u Cristo unqꞌa kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ? As aꞌn la oksal veꞌt iqꞌii Aak tul uvaꞌ la ok Aak tu almikaꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.

As aꞌ xeꞌtkat Aak tiꞌ unqꞌa yoleꞌ uveꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Moisés. As tal veꞌt Aak unpajte tiꞌ unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ alel kan taꞌn kaꞌt unqꞌa qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ. As tal veꞌt Aak isuuchil unqꞌa yoleꞌ te chajnaj uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan tiꞌ Aak.
As tul oon veꞌt chajnaj tziꞌ u tal tenameꞌ uvaꞌ yakikkat chajnaj, as tal veꞌt u Jesús uvaꞌ yakik veꞌt Aak tu umaꞌt tenam.
As iyaꞌlu veꞌt chajnaj Aak. Ech tal chajnaj ileꞌ te Aak: —Kaaen kan sukukꞌatz, tan maꞌt veꞌt kuꞌ qꞌii. As tuk tzꞌotinoj veꞌteꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj. As ok veꞌt Aak kꞌatz chajnaj tu kabꞌal.
As tul xonlik veꞌt u Jesús tukꞌ chajnaj vatz u meexhaeꞌ tiꞌ itxꞌaꞌneꞌ, as itxey veꞌt Aak u paaneꞌ. As taqꞌ veꞌt Aak taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ stiꞌ. As ijatx veꞌt Aak te chajnaj.
As tul ikꞌul veꞌt chajnaj u paaneꞌ, as texhla veꞌt chajnaj uvaꞌ aꞌik u Jesús. As oora kuxh sotz veꞌt Aak vatz chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ svatzaj: —¡As vaꞌlik chit itxuqꞌtxun u qaanxelaleꞌ tul nikat tal Aak isuuchil unqꞌa yoleꞌ sqe tu bꞌey!— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As yak kuxh txakpu veꞌt chajnaj. As qꞌaav veꞌt chajnaj tu u Jerusalén. As tul oon veꞌt chajnaj, as kꞌulik tibꞌ junlaval unqꞌa apóstol tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa apóstol ileꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa niman tetz Aakeꞌ te chajnaj: —¡An chiteꞌ! ¡Kat ulyu veꞌt taama u Kubꞌaal Jesús! Tan kat ikꞌuch tibꞌ Aak te u Simón,— tiꞌke.
As tal veꞌt ok kaꞌvaꞌl unqꞌa najeꞌ te unqꞌa apóstol uvaꞌ kam ibꞌan chajnaj tukꞌ Aak tu bꞌey, as kam ibꞌan chajnaj tul texhla chajnaj Aak tul ijatx Aak u paaneꞌ.
Nikꞌuch tibꞌ u Jesús vatz unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ
As antelik kuxh iyolon unqꞌa najeꞌ, as aat kuxh ilpu veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ txaklik veꞌt u Jesús xoꞌl unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ molik tibꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —As bꞌaꞌnoj etatin sevatzaj sekajayil,— tiꞌk Aak.
As teqꞌo veꞌt taama unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ. As xoꞌv veꞌteꞌ, tan kamal xoꞌval uvaꞌ nikat tal veꞌteꞌ.
As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ molik tibꞌ tu kabꞌal: —¿Kam uveꞌ nu kuxh exoꞌveꞌ as nu kuxh ikaꞌkabꞌin etaama?

Etiltaj vunqꞌabꞌeꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa vojeꞌ, tan ineꞌ taꞌ. As ekantaj in aqꞌal uvaꞌ la pal ex stuul tiꞌ etexhlat in, tan yeꞌl ichibꞌil as yeꞌl ibꞌajil unqꞌa xoꞌvaleꞌ ati. Pet ech koj in, tan il unchiꞌol ati tukꞌ unbꞌajil echeꞌ uvaꞌ netileꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.
As tul kuxh tal u Jesús u yoleꞌ, as ikꞌuch veꞌt Aak viqꞌabꞌeꞌ tukꞌ u tojeꞌ te chajnaj.

As kꞌuxh vaꞌlik chit ichiibꞌ veꞌt chajnaj, as nikat teqꞌo taama chajnaj, tan yeꞌxnik inima chajnaj uvaꞌ maꞌtik tul taama u Jesús. Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ ech tal Aak ileꞌ te chajnaj: —¿Ma at echbꞌubꞌal sexeꞌ? Ebꞌantaj bꞌaꞌnil. Etaqꞌ unbꞌooj vetz,— tiꞌk Aak.
As taqꞌ veꞌt chajnaj unbꞌiil u bꞌoxiꞌm txay te Aak tukꞌ unbꞌiit u txꞌix kabꞌ.
As ikꞌul veꞌt Aak. As techbꞌu veꞌt Aak vatz chajnaj.

As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ te chajnaj: —As jankꞌal chit unqꞌa kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ uveꞌ kat unpalebꞌe, as aꞌeꞌ uveꞌ kat val sete bꞌaxa tul yeꞌxnaj kam in. As techal chit kat ibꞌana kam unqꞌa veeꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan sviꞌ taꞌn u Moisés tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ, tukꞌ u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal tu Salmo,— tiꞌk Aak.
As taqꞌ veꞌt Aak itxumbꞌal chajnaj tiꞌ uvaꞌ la pal chajnaj tu yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan tiꞌ Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ te chajnaj: —Ech ni tal unqꞌa yol ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan sviꞌ: «La chit ipalebꞌe u Cristo u kamchileꞌ. As titoxvu qꞌii la ul taama unpajte.

As tukꞌ vibꞌii Aakeꞌ la alpukat isuuchil u yoleꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ikꞌaxa tibꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ vipaaveꞌ as la sotzsal veꞌt ipaav. As aꞌ la xeꞌtkat tu u Jerusalén tiꞌ talax isuuchil u yoleꞌ,» tiꞌk u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan sviꞌ.
As exeꞌ tuk paxsan veꞌt unqꞌa yoleꞌ sviꞌ, tan exeꞌ kat abꞌin as exeꞌ kat ilon kam uvaꞌ kat ulbꞌel in.
Pet kaaoj kan ex tzitzaꞌ tu u Jerusalén. As lanal ekꞌul veyakꞌileꞌ uveꞌ la kuꞌ chꞌuꞌl tu almikaꞌ, tan tuk unchaj tzan u lochol etetzeꞌ uveꞌ alel kan taꞌn vunBꞌaaleꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
Nijeꞌ u Jesús tu almikaꞌ
As teqꞌo veꞌt el u Jesús unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ tiꞌeꞌl u Jerusalén. As tul oon Aak tukꞌ chajnaj najlich u Betania, as taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ Aak iqꞌabꞌ, as bꞌaꞌn veꞌt iyolon Aak tiꞌ chajnaj.
As tul kuxh tal Aak u bꞌaꞌneꞌ tiꞌ chajnaj, as ijetzꞌ veꞌt el tibꞌ Aak. As aat kuxh til veꞌt chajnaj teqꞌol veꞌt jeꞌ Aak tu almikaꞌ.
As toksa veꞌt chajnaj iqꞌii u Jesús. As qꞌaav veꞌt chajnaj tu u Jerusalén. As vaꞌlik chit itxuqꞌtxun veꞌt chajnaj.
As jun qꞌii nikat imol veꞌt tibꞌ chajnaj tu u tostiixheꞌ tiꞌ toksal iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ. An chiteꞌ.
